title: Riot Games unveils VCT Pacific partnered teams for 2027

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – VALORANT Champions Tour (VCT) Pacific 2027 has unveiled the eight organizations that will each represent a region as a partnered team.

The list includes Crazy Raccoon, FULL SENSE, GAM Esports, Gen.G, Paper Rex, Rex Regum Qeon (RRQ), T1, and ZETA DIVISION, combining returning organizations with new additions to the league’s partnership program.
How the selection process worked
Riot Games said that the process is highly competitive and took several months to go through, and applications were received from many esports organizations.
The company emphasized that the main criteria for choosing organizations were that they had a long-term impact on the development of VALORANT and that they would bring more fans to the esports.
Riot Games added that its decisions were based on four key criteria:

items: Organizations that prioritize fans, celebrate the diversity of the community, and remain committed to supporting professional players.
Organizations that have established strong connections with fans through engaging content, a compelling brand, and an exciting roster.
Organizations that prioritize long-term growth and sustainability.
Organizations that can activate their home regions and bring together their local communities.

Meet the VCT Pacific 2027 partnered teams
Crazy Raccoon is a Japanese esports organization known for its presence in competitive VALORANT.

The team made its mark on the international stage in 2021, qualifying for Masters Reykjavík, Masters Berlin, and VALORANT Champions, before returning to the spotlight with its selection for the VCT Pacific 2027 partnership program.
FULL SENSE is a Thai esports organization that gained international recognition through its VALORANT division.
The team competed for a place at VALORANT Champions in 2021 and has continued to represent Thailand in the regional competitive scene, earning a place among the VCT Pacific partners for 2027.
GAM Esports is one of Vietnam’s most prominent esports organizations, best known for its achievements in League of Legends.
Its selection for the VCT Pacific 2027 partnership program marks a new chapter for the organization as it prepares to establish its presence in competitive VALORANT.
Gen.G is a South Korean esports squad that competes in various competitive games such as VALORANT.
The team secured a victory at VCT Pacific Kickoff in 2024, and went on to win its first international VALORANT championship in 2024 at Masters Shanghai, making it one of the top teams in the region.
Paper Rex is a Singapore-based esports organization recognized for its aggressive playing style, international success, and passionate fan base.
The team has established itself as one of the leading organizations in the VCT Pacific scene, adding to its international achievements with a Masters Toronto title in 2025.
Rex Regum Qeon, commonly known as RRQ, is an Indonesian esports organization competing across multiple titles.
Since joining VCT Pacific in 2023, its VALORANT division has remained a regular presence in the regional circuit and captured its first VCT Pacific Stage 1 title in 2025.
T1 is a South Korean esports organization widely recognized for its success in League of Legends and other competitive titles.
After entering VALORANT in 2020, the organization became a VCT Pacific partnered team in 2023 and secured its first international VALORANT trophy by winning Masters Bangkok in 2025.
ZETA DIVISION is a Japanese esports company which joined competitive VALORANT in 2020.

They immediately made a name for themselves in the Japanese home market with victory at the Japanese Ignition Series and First Strike Japan, and were one of the groups representing Japan in the VCT Pacific partnership program.

Riot Games expressed confidence that the selected organizations would help set a standard for their respective regions and contribute to the continued growth of VALORANT esports across local and regional competitions. (By David Buenaventura, INQUIRER.net Intern)
